## Samsung reportedly raising chip manufacturing prices 15% on solid demand

Foundry price hikes of this magnitude, if confirmed, would be a leading indicator that the cycle has turned and available capacity is being absorbed — watch for TSMC pricing signals and whether logic customers are absorbing or pushing back on cost increases.

- Samsung is hiking foundry manufacturing prices approximately 15%, per report, citing solid demand conditions.
- Bullish pricing signal for the semiconductor supply/demand balance after an extended cycle downturn.
- If confirmed, price discipline suggests capacity tightness is returning across the foundry ecosystem.
- Positive read-through for logic and memory peers if demand conditions are broad-based.
